qualification_policy.grasp_assistance: declared ideal rigid grasp for initial implementation

current_evidence.note_zh: 原版只在声明的理想辅助抓持与参考动作下完成；受力直拉仍有失败。概念图不能作为最终几何或可解性证据。

shared_rules.density_policy: Keep declared physical density fixed; recompute mass and inertia from each final solid
shared_rules.family_identity: Ordered relative SE(3) motion and functional blocking features, not color, global placement, speed, or an arbitrary IK branch
shared_rules.instance_identity: Final geometry + grasp frames + full joint trajectory + collision/solver profile + acceptance evidence
shared_rules.coordinate_policy: Family-local intrinsic axes; world placement jointly optimized for both arms
shared_rules.baseline_preservation: Original Claw meshes, source trajectory and archived demo remain immutable
shared_rules.clearance_policy: Derive margin from independently bounded geometry error, relative tracking error including angular motion, interpolation error and reserve; no generic certified numeric margin exists yet

families.name_zh: 圆杆回钩 · 空间互绕
families.shape_grammar_zh: 两件分别由连续圆杆和双回弯构成，保留开口端与回钩顺序；改变回弯跨度、高宽比例和前后层次。
families.motion_signature_zh: 沿原 Claw 解锁轨迹的关键相对构型顺序，多方向转动、错开、抽离。
families.relative_frame: x=main loop span, y=loop depth, z=loop height; establish from a frozen reference feature frame
families.seed: pinned source reference trajectory; key bottleneck segmentation still needs extraction
fixed_mechanism: no inserted screw-only or two-gate action sequence

motion_parameters.policy: Corrections apply at certified bottleneck seeds; constrained continuous re-optimization, not independent pose noise

coupling_rules: Ratios are skeleton design targets, not an affine warp with inherited solvability
Reconstruct both solids from the realized FK sweep while preserving protected interfaces
Recompute turning centers, offsets, grasps and support fixtures; never scale stored joint angles
negative_controls: six-axis straight separation in the family frame
replace a curved transition by a direct shortcut

representatives.visual_zh: 保留原始双回弯圆杆，作为默认实模基准。
representatives.ik_zh: 已有原参考全过程 IK 与辅助抓持物理运行。

representatives.visual_zh: 两件主回弯显著横向展开，前后层次较浅，装配呈横向宽展开轮廓。
representatives.ik_zh: 同一关键通过顺序；扩大侧向错开和绕行半径，重新求双臂 IK。

representatives.visual_zh: 主回弯高窄、回钩更深；正面比例和侧面层次都区别于 A0/A1。
representatives.ik_zh: 同一通过顺序；增加出平面错开和转向避让，重新求双臂 IK。

families.name_zh: 螺旋冠 · 连续旋转推进
families.shape_grammar_zh: 橙色三条宽螺旋肋以偏置背梁连为一体；蓝色双层错位翼片与回钩由主梁连为一体。
families.motion_signature_zh: 围绕一个共同轴线连续相对旋转并同步轴向推进，到窗口后侧向脱出。
families.relative_frame: z=common screw axis, x/y=radial plane; freeze initial relative orientation for the analytic seed
fixed_mechanism: simultaneous monotone axial advance and rotation

radial_ratio.feature_zh: 螺旋冠径向尺度与翼片跨度

axial_ratio.feature_zh: 冠体高度、层间距及实际推进量

ribbon_width_ratio.feature_zh: 宽肋与翼片的视觉宽度

coupling_rules: Advance, tier spacing, rib pitch and wing positions must change together
For a proven strictly coaxial ideal path only, S=diag(radial_ratio,radial_ratio,axial_ratio) commutes with Rz; transform both bodies and translations consistently
Ribbon width changes require inverse recarving; an ideal geometric transform does not certify realized robot FK, contacts or dynamics
negative_controls: side exit before the aligned window
sequential turn-then-push instead of the target coupled motion

representatives.visual_zh: 高宽均衡的宽肋冠体与双层错位翼芯。
representatives.ik_zh: 相对转动 100° 同步推进 40 mm，再侧向脱出；双臂分担转动。

representatives.visual_zh: 冠体矮宽、翼片横展且宽肋更饱满，具有扇盘状轮廓。
representatives.ik_zh: 保持同步螺旋动作；候选推进 32 mm，增加径向夹持及手臂避让。

representatives.visual_zh: 径向收拢、轴向拉长、层间错位更明显，形成细高塔状轮廓。
representatives.ik_zh: 保持同步螺旋动作；候选推进 50 mm，扩大轴向分离及放置空间。

families.name_zh: 正交双窗 · 分段换轴翻转
families.shape_grammar_zh: 两扇近正交厚框经偏置侧梁形成一个阶梯框；另一件为宽片、折弯脊梁及带回唇分叉组成的折翼件。
families.motion_signature_zh: 内推到转向腔、第一轴翻转、横移与升降到第二窗、第二轴翻转、退出。
families.relative_frame: x=insertion direction, y=inter-window transfer, z=step height; roll about x then pitch about y for the seed
fixed_mechanism: one asymmetric folded wing with paddle and fork

window_width_ratio.feature_zh: 窗口宽度及相配宽片跨度

window_offset_ratio.feature_zh: 两窗横向错位与桥梁跨度

cavity_depth_ratio.feature_zh: 转向腔深度与内推距离

step_height_ratio.feature_zh: 台阶高差与两头竖向间距

coupling_rules: Resize both gate openings and the folded wing together; derive transfer and turning-space requirements from final solids
Nonuniform scaling does not generally commute with two orthogonal rotations; recarve and recertify each candidate
Update each later pivot after the intervening translation; do not retain an obsolete rotation center

representatives.visual_zh: 两个近正交厚框与不对称 Z 形折翼，台阶和转向腔比例均衡。
representatives.ik_zh: 内推 30 mm、翻转、横移 40 mm 并升高 25 mm、换轴翻转后退出。

representatives.visual_zh: 窗口更宽、桥梁横向拉长，折翼两头跨度同步增加。
representatives.ik_zh: 保留两次换轴翻转，候选窗间横移扩大到 56 mm。

representatives.visual_zh: 台阶更高、转向腔更深，折翼脊梁更长；侧面呈明显高低层次。
representatives.ik_zh: 保留顺序，候选内推增至 40.5 mm、升高 33.75 mm；窗间横移为 36 mm。

visual_acceptance.action_comparison: Compare phase-aligned relative SE(3) paths resampled by geometric arc length, removing common world motion; assess physical full-scene videos too

acceptance_gates.name: profile_contact_qualification
acceptance_gates.requires: Independent free-motion, blocked motion and gravity controls; no explosive response or unresolved geometry/contact-proxy disagreement. The existing source profile currently fails.

acceptance_gates.name: solid_validity
acceptance_gates.requires: Exactly two connected watertight solids; no self-intersection, full containment, cut-away grasps, disconnected blockers or walls below the declared fabrication/collision limits; recomputed mass and inertia

acceptance_gates.name: relative_path_certificate
acceptance_gates.requires: Initial noninterpenetration, complete separation, conservative continuous clearance under the actual joint-interpolation FK; check all intervals and final exported geometry, not only waypoints

acceptance_gates.name: action_signature_and_negative_controls
acceptance_gates.requires: Target path valid and preregistered shortcut/action-omission controls blocked with actual overlap witnesses; failure to certify is not proof of overlap; no claim of global uniqueness

acceptance_gates.name: robot_grasp_and_environment
acceptance_gates.requires: Both arms reconstruct their piece poses, joint/velocity limits, whole-robot collisions including swept intermediates, table/support clearance, realizable grasp interfaces; record continuous versus sampled scope

acceptance_gates.name: visual_distinction
acceptance_gates.requires: Clearly distinguish all three families and all three same-family anchors under the shared image protocol

acceptance_gates.name: full_dynamics_and_half_step
acceptance_gates.requires: Continuous bounded-control execution from declared start through placement, release, withdrawal and free stable dwell; no post-initialization pose overwrite; retained source force limits; repeat at half timestep with predeclared tolerances

acceptance_gates.name: release_record
acceptance_gates.requires: All prior gates passed with geometry/grasp/trace/profile/code hashes; synchronized full-run videos and immutable evidence; otherwise remain candidate

sampling_plan.family_sampling: balanced per-family quotas with within-family retries; do not globally reject into an easier-family bias
sampling_plan.anchor_sampling: balanced over each family's three released anchors
sampling_plan.proposal_domain: correlated neighborhoods of independently accepted anchors, not Cartesian products of per-axis extrema
sampling_plan.exhausted_behavior: return explicit no-qualified-instance with rejection reasons; never substitute another family or an unverified model
sampling_plan.first_expansion_target: 20 separately accepted geometry+IK+physics instances per family after all nine anchors pass; does not certify a continuous region
sampling_plan.split_policy: Group by functional geometry, parent motion and neighborhood lineage; color-only copies stay in one split

milestones: M0: diagnose/replace the failing nonconvex contact representation and qualify the physical profile; retain the original failed evidence
M1: independently build and qualify A0, B0 and C0 with clearly distinct relative motions and solid geometry
M2: build A1/A2/B1/B2/C1/C2; all nine anchors independently pass the same acceptance protocol
M3: expand local conditional proposal neighborhoods and fill balanced validated banks
M4: enable the released-instance sampler; consider certificate-backed online synthesis separately
